cohort: 457 women with single pregnancy and breech presentation at term (70 with previous caesarean section and 387 multiparous)
finding: ECV in women with previous caesarean section has a comparable success rate to that of multiparous women, with uncommon complications.
mod_finding: The success rate of external cephalic version (ECV) was similar between women with previous cesarean sections and multiparous women, and the vaginal delivery rate was lower in the cesarean section group.
